snippet.title: My Cannibal Family Reveal Trailer - Future Games Show Summer Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist here - store.steampowered.com/app/3153700

A theme park simulator where you're trying to eat the guests, My Cannibal Family has you constructing an attractive rest stop to lure (and harvest) unlucky visitors. It's coming to PC and consoles in 2027, but there's a playtest available on Steam right now.
https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
